sentences.en: There should be an harmonious relation between student and teacher.
sentences.zh: 学生和老师之间应该有一种和谐的关系。

sentences.en: The villa was harmonious with the scenery.
sentences.zh: 这座别墅与周围的景色非常协调。

sentences.en: Harmonious spouses can even empty all the water out of the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 和睦的夫妻甚至可以把太平洋里的水都舀空。

senses.zh: 和谐的，和睦的；协调的，调和的 - 音调优美的；悦耳的
